s2.quote: Plongez dans des canyons impressionnants s'étendant de 12 à 60 mètres de profondeur.

summary.text: Giant canyons on the north Caribbean coast of Martinique near Saint-Pierre, running from about 12-15 m down past 60 m. The upper canyons suit newer divers while the floor is for deep-certified divers.
